# Mor & Cinnamon (מור וקינמון | קייטרינג והפקה)

> Catering and production for outdoor weddings and events in Israel: weddings on the family farm (משק), in orchards, groves and open fields, produced from the first plan to the last drink. Local, seasonal, fresh and creative food; events produced to measure.

- Catering: live stations cooked over open fire and on the plancha (fresh pasta with seasonal tomatoes, skewers and meats, whole vegetables on the embers, grilled sweet potato, bruschetta), dishes served to the table, dessert tables (pavlova, chocolate cake, choux tower, crumble). Menus rewritten for each event; priced on request.
- Production: setup in the field (tables, chairs, tents, tipis, pergolas), lounges and styling, lighting, kitchen and service staff, coordination of designers, sound, bar and photographers, running the wedding day.
- Recent weddings: Roni & Itay, Hila & Rotem, Einav & Davidi (on her parents' farm), Noam & Nadav, Adi & Nimi.
- Contact: WhatsApp and phone +972 50-536-8876; Instagram https://www.instagram.com/mor.ve.cin/
- Quote requests: event type, guests, estimated date, venue (found or still looking), kosher or not, how you found us, services (catering, production or both), budget.
